protocol.floor: 2nd percentile of four foot marker heights over clip
protocol.contact_candidate: marker <= floor+0.05m AND abs vertical velocity<0.20m/s, sustained >=3 transitions (0.15s)
protocol.conservative_speed: minimum horizontal speed among candidate ankle/toe markers per foot (allows foot rolling)
protocol.aggregation: task medians over per-clip values; no-contact clips excluded from contact-conditioned metrics
protocol.caveat: Heuristic contact candidates, not ground-truth foot contacts or validated pass/fail rates. Flat-floor assumption; no mesh sole, terrain or force data.
